headline: Huawei Convicted on 10 Counts in US Criminal Case
summary: Chinese technology giant Huawei was convicted by a New York jury on 10 counts in a nearly decade-long criminal case charging that it deceived banks about its business dealings.
why: Criminal convictions of major multinational technology providers carry legal and financial risks that restrict international banking and operational expansion.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Criminal convictions against prominent technology firms expose legal liabilities and cross-border commercial restrictions.
